about: Cases that the deployment tools (web/deploy/plasma_web: server_ini.py, deployment.py INITIAL_GRAPHICS_INI) and the page (Sources/Plasma/Apps/plClient/emscripten/shell/config.mjs: validateServerIni, INITIAL_GRAPHICS_INI) are both tested against (web/tests/test_rules.py). accept: what both readers do (the page refuses every case the tools refuse). why: the reason a case is refused, where it is not plain. In serverIni texts, $KEYS stands for the six key lines (Server.Auth/Game/Gate.N/X, each the 64-byte key $KEY) and $KEY for that key in canonical base64.

cases.name: the shard's own layout: keys, auth and gatekeeper hosts
gatekeeper only: the entry host is Server.Gate.Host
a file host of its own
no final line end, a trailing CR
comment lines, blank lines, indented and trailing comments
cases.text:
# one

   
$KEYS	Server.Auth.Host "192.0.2.174"   # the auth server
Server.Gate.Host 192.0.2.174 ; bare
Server.Status "https://status.example.test/s" // trailing

cases.name: names in any ASCII case, a bare host
cases.text:
server.auth.n "$KEY"
SERVER.AUTH.X "$KEY"
Server.Game.n "$KEY"
Server.Game.x "$KEY"
server.gate.N "$KEY"
server.GATE.x "$KEY"
server.auth.host 192.0.2.174

cases.name: a trailing comment with quoted and quote-like text
cases.text:
$KEYSServer.Auth.Host "192.0.2.174"#glued to a quoted value
Server.Status "https://status.example.test/s" # "quoted" and don't

cases.name: status, signup and display name with spaces and non-ASCII text in quotes
cases.text:
$KEYSServer.Auth.Host "192.0.2.174"
Server.Status "http://status.example.test/serverstatus?x=1"
Server.Signup "https://example.test/sign up"
Server.DispName "Shard démo — test"

cases.name: a setting with '=' (pfConsoleParser reads it, the readers do not)
a missing key
cases.text:
Server.Auth.N "$KEY"
Server.Auth.X "$KEY"
Server.Game.N "$KEY"
Server.Gate.N "$KEY"
Server.Gate.X "$KEY"
Server.Auth.Host "192.0.2.174"

cases.name: a key that is not 64 bytes
a key in non-canonical base64 (pad bits set)
a key with a space in it
a host with a character outside letters, digits, dots and hyphens
a port with a leading zero
a port in other digits than ASCII
a port that is not a number
a generator with a leading zero
a line break inside a line (lone CR) after a value
a no-break space inside a bare value
a no-break space between name and value
cases.why: pfConsoleParser separates tokens with spaces and tabs only, so the client would read one unknown setting name

cases.name: a form feed between name and value
cases.why: a form feed is not one of pfConsoleParser's token separators

cases.name: a lone CR between name and value
cases.why: hsStream::ReadLn ends a line at a CR, so the client would read a setting without its value

cases.name: a byte order mark
cases.why: the client reads the mark as part of the first setting's name

cases.name: a no-break space before a comment line
cases.why: the tools trim ASCII whitespace only

cases.name: a ';' comment line (test_pfServerIni.cpp semicolon_and_slash_comment_lines)
cases.why: hsStream::ReadLn skips only lines that start with '#'; pfServerIni reads ';' as an unknown setting

cases.name: a '//' comment line (test_pfServerIni.cpp semicolon_and_slash_comment_lines)
cases.why: hsStream::ReadLn skips only lines that start with '#'; pfServerIni reads '//' as an unknown setting

cases.name: an indented '#' comment line
cases.why: hsStream::ReadLn skips a comment only where '#' is the line's first character; pfServerIni reads '#' as an unknown setting

cases.name: a bare key (test_pfServerIni.cpp bare_values)
cases.why: pfConsoleTokenizer::NextArgument ends a bare value at '=': the key loses its "==" and ParseBase64KeyInto refuses it

cases.name: a bare URL with a query (test_pfServerIni.cpp bare_values)
cases.why: pfConsoleTokenizer::NextArgument ends a bare value at '=': the client reads http://status.example.test/s?x

cases.name: a bare value with a comma (test_pfServerIni.cpp bare_values)
cases.why: pfConsoleTokenizer::NextArgument ends a bare value at ',': the client reads a

cases.name: a value in single quotes
cases.why: pfConsoleTokenizer::NextArgument reads text in single quotes as quoted; the tools read double quotes only

cases.name: a comment right after a bare value
cases.why: the client reads 192.0.2.174#x as the value: nothing ends a bare value at '#'

cases.name: an unterminated quote in a trailing comment
cases.why: the client reads a trailing comment as more arguments and refuses one that opens a quote it does not close
